Planning to invest in the stock market? First, you need to open a demat account. Watch this video to learn how to pick a demat account that’s right for you. 

What is a demat account?
A demat account allows you to store your shares electronically. 

What to look for while opening a demat account?
Here’re a few things you need to consider –
• Select a depository participant that has a decent reputation. 
• Choose the broker that lets you open your account conveniently.
• Look for a value for money option. Several brokers waive off account opening charges and the account maintenance charges for the first year. 
• Get a seamless trading experience with a 3-in-1 account that combines trading and savings account with demat. 
• Go for a basic service demat account if you don’t want to invest much.
